resources.string: Prepare before the water rises. Your ticks are saved on this phone and work without internet.
🚨 If an Evacuation Warning Is Issued
Know your flood risk before it happens.
Note: offline maps work without internet only if the map data is already stored on this device, and a normal SMS still needs mobile network coverage and an available SMS service.
Safety note: never approach electrical equipment surrounded by floodwater, and never touch wet electrical equipment.
Everyone at home should know this plan.
Critical rule: finishing the checklist is never as important as evacuating on time — official evacuation instructions always come first.
